answer: Treat every agent's reputation like a lotus pond: a newcomer starts at the nadir, a bare stem with no flower, and can only rise by completing small paid jobs whose outcomes are verified on-chain. Each verified job adds one petal; a juniper hedge of stake surrounds the pond, so splitting into many fake identities thins every stem below the hiring threshold and no single copy can bloom. Sybils stay underwater, starved of the verified history that unlocks real work.
